description: What happens when something goes wrong or needs a human. Defined once, centrally, so no workflow has to invent its own unhappy path.

failure_ladder.when: provider chain has a next entry and the failure is provider-shaped
a lower-fidelity output still satisfies the brief
examples: still image instead of generated clip

failure_ladder.note: Never discard completed work because a sibling failed. Publish what is green, park what is not.
Full envelope + provenance is preserved so the run can be replayed byte-identically after a fix.

compensation.policy: Any capability with side_effects of external_write or publish MUST declare a compensation capability. On a downstream hard failure the orchestrator walks the provenance array backwards and invokes each compensation in reverse order.
compensation.note: Telegram sends and email broadcasts are NOT compensable — they are delivered the instant they are made. Those are exactly the capabilities that carry the strictest approval gates.

modes.none: Autonomous. Available only to tenants above the trust threshold on unregulated verticals and organic channels.
modes.sampled: A configurable percentage is held for review; the rest flows. Keeps a human in the loop without making them the bottleneck.
modes.channel_conditional: Held based on channel blast radius: paid and owned-list channels always held, organic social sampled, internal drafts never.

timeout.note: Silence is never consent. An unanswered approval expires into the parked state, it does not fall through into a post.

trust_ladder.description: How a tenant earns autonomy. Mechanical, observable, and reversible — not a checkbox someone ticks on day one.

levels.name: sampled
levels.criteria: 25+ runs, approval rate >= 0.9, zero compliance blocks in 30d

levels.name: autonomous_organic
levels.criteria: 100+ runs, approval rate >= 0.95, zero compliance blocks in 90d, unregulated vertical

trust_ladder.demotion: Any compliance block, any human rejection for a factual error, or any published-then-deleted item drops the tenant one level immediately.

digest: daily cost by tenant and capability
